blocks.text: Lots and land in Greentree Village

items.t: Greentree Village (City of Burnaby Greentree Village Community Plan, Manager's Report No. 72, Rezoning #1/72, dated Nov 6, 1972): a roughly 50-acre planned site south of Canada Way behind BCIT, bounded by Wayburne Drive (W), Woodsworth Street (N), Forest Lawn Cemetery (E) and Moscrop Street (S), planned for about 450 units at 12 units per acre. That 1972 plan is the subdivision document for this ground: the village streets (Garden Grove Drive, Fernglen Drive/Place, Cedarglen Place, Laurelwood Place, Elmgrove Drive, Driftwood Place, Village Drive) are its built fabric, not a current lot offering, and no lot sizes, lot counts for sale, or prices are stated — none exists as an offering. Servicing as the plan/source states it: no parcel-level servicing statement for the village is quoted in the sources read — City water/sewer position for a specific parcel: confirm with the City.

How the plan was built out (cross-reference only, no recount): the village was delivered as multiple strata townhouse phases, each phase its own strata corporation. Detached houses also sit on village streets; they are single-family homes, not a land offering.
Surrounding and in-village detached lots: fee-simple single-family houses ring the strata phases and sit on some village streets — the freehold side of the pocket.

Servicing, as the City states it (city-wide frame): Burnaby's 2026 residential utility notice covers annual water, annual sewer use, a cross-connection device charge where applicable, and a residential garbage toter fee; the detached single-family dwelling water charge is $652.33, rates carry a 5% discount if paid by the due date, and for single-family homes sewer is billed as a sewer parcel tax on the property tax notice. Parcel-level servicing for a specific lot: confirm with the City.
ALR vs non-ALR: no ALR split is documented for this pocket, and no ALR percentage is stated. Parcel-level ALR status is checked in the Agricultural Land Commission's ALR Property and Map Finder.

Hazard position, corrected pocket: For the corrected Canada Way / Deer Lake pocket, parcel-level hazard and streamside status (Deer Lake edge) is a property-specific check: Not verified for individual lots.

No bare-land strata plan in Greentree Village was verified: The village's strata phases are building strata (townhouses on strata lots within a built complex), which is a different form from a bare-land strata subdivision.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Greentree Village

items.t: Greentree Village, on the corrected geography followed here, is a small planned pocket in the City of Burnaby south of Canada Way and Highway 1, behind BCIT and west of Deer Lake: a roughly 50-acre site bounded by Wayburne Drive (W), Woodsworth Street (N), Forest Lawn Cemetery (E) and Moscrop Street (S), planned in 1972 for about 450 units at 12 units per acre. The village streets are Garden Grove Drive, Fernglen Drive/Place, Cedarglen Place, Laurelwood Place, Elmgrove Drive, Driftwood Place and Village Drive. "Greentree Village" is the GVR board sub-area name in the SnapStats GVR September 2026 report under community "Burnaby." City use of "Greentree Village" as an official neighbourhood name beyond its 1972 community plan was not confirmed.
Roads and transit, corrected pocket: Canada Way is the arterial along the pocket's north side. Commute times in minutes: Not verified.
Schools, corrected pocket: SD41 (Burnaby) operates 41 elementary and 8 secondary schools city-wide, with no middle-school tier — elementary K–7, secondary 8–12.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Greentree Village

items.t: SSMUH / subdivision potential as the City states it (surrounding fee-simple house lots only, NOT the strata townhouse parcels): R1 lots may hold 3 units on lots up to 280 m², 4 units on larger lots, and 6 units on lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent-transit stop; lots with two or more primary units may be stratified; SSMUH lots require a minimum lot width of 10 m and a minimum lot area of 281 m²; permitted forms include single-family homes, duplexes, multiplexes, rowhouses and secondary suites.

Strata block (applies to the village's building-strata phases; no bare-land strata is verified here): Form B diligence (provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page) — each Greentree phase is its own strata corporation with its own Form B, CRF and depreciation report; depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022 (short-term restrictions may still apply by bylaw); only 55+ age bylaws valid under SPA ss.123.1/123.2, with May 1, 2023 exemptions; a listing's "45+" line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw.

ALR rules (for completeness — no Greentree Village ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha).

faq.a: In the V5G pocket south of Canada Way behind BCIT, at the west edge of Deer Lake — bounded by Wayburne Drive, Woodsworth Street, Forest Lawn Cemetery and Moscrop Street under the City's 1972 Greentree Village Community Plan.

faq.q: Can I buy a vacant lot in Greentree Village?
faq.a: No verified one — the village is completed 1970s stock: strata townhouse phases plus detached houses on village streets. No lot offering, bare-land strata or presale lot sale was verified.

faq.q: Is a Greentree townhouse phase a bare-land strata?
faq.a: A bare-land strata (owning a lot inside a strata plan) is a different form, and none was verified here.
Not verified by locator — listings state Gilpin Elementary and Moscrop Secondary for village addresses, but no completed SD41 locator run is documented. Run the exact address in the SD41 locator.

faq.q: How many homes can a surrounding R1 house lot hold?
faq.a: 3 units on lots up to 280 m², 4 on larger lots, and 6 on lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent-transit stop; minimum lot width 10 m and minimum lot area 281 m² for SSMUH lots. That rule does not redevelop a strata townhouse parcel.

faq.q: Where is Greentree Village in Burnaby?
faq.a: On Burnaby's south slope around Marlborough Avenue and Sussex Avenue, near École Marlborough Elementary, west of Metrotown; "Greentree Village" is the GVR MLS® sub-area name, matching the local townhome pocket (SnapStats, September 2026)

faq.q: Which school is in Greentree Village?
faq.a: École Marlborough Elementary (K–7), 6060 Marlborough Ave — a French Immersion program school; Immersion entry is application-based, and the catchment for any specific address must be checked in the SD41 School Locator.
